sections.Profile:
The "Indiana Jones" pinball machine by Stern, released in April 2008, integrates themes from four Indiana Jones movies. Designed by John Borg with artwork by Kevin O'Connor, this machine offers a variety of unique features and engaging gameplay elements. Key features include toys like the Ark of the Covenant, a Crystal Skull, and the Holy Grail, which serve as interactive elements on the playfield. The game includes eight multiball modes and various themed missions, such as the "Raiders Multiball," "Temple of Doom Multiball," and "Last Crusade Mode".
